summary: Sega Technical Institute's cult comic-book beat 'em up, originally for Genesis and later rereleased through Sega collections, PC, mobile, and Nintendo's Genesis app.

entries.title: Comix Zone
entries.definitive_edition: Owned PC Sega Classics release, with Nintendo Switch Online as current fallback

emulation.emulator: SEGA Classics wrapper, Nintendo Switch Online Genesis app, or Genesis Plus GX
emulation.notes: Use official PC/Switch routes where possible; avoid the old Windows 3.1 MIDI port and GBA version for a main capture run.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Genesis/Mega Drive original presentation with emulator scaling and filters.

primary.version: SEGA Mega Drive and Genesis Classics / owned Steam release
primary.why: The PC Sega Classics route is the most capture-friendly official emulation path when already owned; the original Genesis game content is preserved, while the separate 1995 Windows port used a MIDI soundtrack and the GBA port was compromised by the smaller screen.
primary.how_to_play: Play an owned PC Sega Classics copy for capture if available. If not, use the Nintendo Switch Online Genesis app, original Genesis/Mega Drive hardware, or another official compilation route.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The Genesis game content is preserved across official emulated routes; the main caveat is access after Sega Classics delisting.

entries.remaster_caveats: This is an emulated classic, not a remaster. Select Classics games and bundles were delisted after December 6, 2024 but remain playable for owners.
